import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

    'font.family': 'serif',

    'mathtext.fontset': 'cm',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,

    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',

    'axes.spines.right': False,
    'lines.linewidth': 1.8,
})

rho = [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.6]
delta = [+0.046, +0.002, -0.020, -0.032]
sd = [None, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.006]
n_seeds = [1, 3, 3, 3]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(5, 3.5))

# 连线贯穿所有点
ax.plot(rho, delta, '-', color='#0072B2', linewidth=1.8, zorder=2)

# 实心点 (N=3: rho=0.3, 0.4, 0.6)
for i in [1, 2, 3]:
    yerr = [[sd[i]], [sd[i]]]
    ax.errorbar(rho[i], delta[i], yerr=yerr, fmt='o', color='#0072B2',
                markersize=7, capsize=4, capthick=1, elinewidth=1, zorder=3)

# 空心点 (N=1: rho=0.2)
ax.plot(rho[0], delta[0], 'o', markersize=7, markerfacecolor='white',
        markeredgecolor='#0072B2', markeredgewidth=1.5, zorder=3)

# 零线
ax.axhline(0, color='black', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

# Transition zone
ax.axvspan(0.3, 0.4, alpha=0.15, color='gray', zorder=0)
ax.text(0.35, -0.012, 'transition\nzone', fontsize=8, fontstyle='italic',
        color='gray', ha='center', va='top')

# 标注: harmful (rho=0.2 上方偏右)
ax.annotate('harmful', xy=(rho[0], delta[0]), xytext=(rho[0] + 0.04, delta[0] + 0.008),
            fontsize=8, color='#D62728', fontstyle='italic',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#D62728', lw=0.6))

# 标注: effective (rho=0.6 下方偏左)
ax.annotate('effective', xy=(rho[3], delta[3]), xytext=(rho[3] - 0.08, delta[3] - 0.012),
            fontsize=8, color='#2CA02C', fontstyle='italic',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#2CA02C', lw=0.6))

ax.set_xlabel(r'$\rho$ (Contamination Ratio)')
ax.set_ylabel(r'$\Delta$ PPL (Adaptive $-$ Uniform)')
ax.set_xticks(rho)

import os
os.makedirs('/root/provenance_weight_training/figures', exist_ok=True)
fig.savefig('/root/provenance_weight_training/figures/delta_vs_rho.pdf')
fig.savefig('/root/provenance_weight_training/figures/delta_vs_rho.png')
plt.close()
print('Done.')
